abort.already_configured: This Flame King scale is already configured.
abort.not_supported: The discovered Bluetooth device does not match a supported Flame King scale.

error.invalid_area: The selected room no longer exists. Choose another room.
error.invalid_name: Enter a name for this scale.
error.no_devices_found: No supported Flame King scale was found. Turn on the scale, close any app connected to it, and scan again.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up the discovered Flame King propane scale {name}. Enter the cylinder's stamped TW and rated propane capacity; these can be changed later from the device page.
bluetooth_confirm.title: Configure discovered propane scale

confirm.description: Set up the discovered Flame King propane scale?
confirm.title: Flame King propane scale discovered

user.description: Home Assistant actively scans for a Gas Monitor advertisement and validates its Flame King Bluetooth fingerprint. No address entry is required. Submit to scan again.
user.title: Find Flame King propane scale

error.no_live_reading: No live reading is available. Turn on the scale, make sure no other app is connected, and try again.
error.same_calibration_points: Raw zero and raw reference must be different.

menu_option_descriptions.advanced: View or enter the raw calibration values directly.
menu_option_descriptions.calibrate: Capture zero and a known weight directly from the connected scale.
menu_option_descriptions.tank: Set the cylinder's stamped tare weight and propane capacity.

tank.description: Enter the cylinder's stamped TW, not an estimate. A typical 20 lb grill cylinder may use an 18 lb tare, but the cylinder stamp is authoritative.
tank.title: Tank settings

calibrate.description: Turn on the scale, remove the cylinder and every other load, and wait for it to settle. Then submit to capture zero automatically. Current raw reading: {raw}.
calibrate.title: Step 1: Capture empty scale

menu_option_descriptions.calibrate_empty_tank: Use the configured stamped tare weight as the known load.
menu_option_descriptions.calibrate_known_weight: Enter the weight of another accurately known load.

calibrate_empty_tank.description: Place the confirmed-empty cylinder on the scale, disconnected from hoses or accessories, and wait for the reading to settle. Its configured tare weight of {tare} lb will be used automatically. Current raw reading: {raw}.
calibrate_empty_tank.title: Capture empty cylinder

calibrate_known_weight.description: Place an accurately known weight on the scale and wait for the reading to settle. Enter only its real weight; the raw reading is captured automatically. Current raw reading: {raw}.
calibrate_known_weight.title: Capture known weight

advanced.description: Diagnostic fallback for manually entering the two raw calibration points. Guided calibration is recommended.
advanced.title: Advanced manual calibration
